When they work together, their combined rate is the sum of their individual rates. So, in one hour, they can paint (1/4) + (1/6) of the room together.

\[

\]

\text{acid you started with} + \text{acid you added} = \text{acid in final mixture}
\]

\[
48(0.20) + x(0.50) = (48+x)(0.30)
\]

\[

\[

So yes, the answer is:

\boxed{24 \text{ liters}}
